Labs have not yet reached the point where their own cash flows can fund the scale of CapEx required, since labs are projected to generate hundreds of billions in revenue next year while total CapEx across the compute supply chain will be well north…

His current modeling has $5 trillion of credit-funded and $6 trillion of cash-funded infrastructure investment through 2029, and this is not enough compute relative to projected AI demand growth, so revenue per megawatt has to keep rising.
